opening.text: I've been short of breath and have a dry cough that brings nothing up. Both started about a month ago. I have rheumatoid arthritis, which has been well controlled, and I've taken methotrexate tablets, 2.5 mg a day, for it for more than 30 years. I also have high blood pressure.
